Requirement: The system shall embed version-pinned agent base instructions in the lbabus binary and expose them via the lbabus agents command (print, --out, --check) so every session on a given version shares byte-identical, hardenable base instructions.
Notes: Embedded resource round-trips (--out then --check exit 0) and drift is detected (--check exit 3); gated by the ci-agents Dockerfile stage in the release harness. Verified locally on Windows and in the Linux container.

Requirement: The system shall close the host<->VM-agent coordination loop over the lbabus net TCP bus -- after driving the reviewer VM's Copilot agent, the host awaits the agent's reply frame correlated by task id (fail-closed on mismatch/timeout) and the signed reviewer verdict announces with a semantic net type (RESOLVED/REFINE/BLOCKED), so a fail-closed gate proves the read-back + the semantic types are correctly derived and coordination rides TCP, not a GitHub Discussion.
Notes: ADR-0039 host<->VM-agent closed loop over TCP: await-agent-reply.mjs runs lbabus net listen + correlates the VM agent's reply by task/type (fail-closed on mismatch/timeout); drive-agent-closed-loop.sh composes keyboard-inject (drive-agent-chat.sh) + await; the net envelope type set (BusWire.Types in Net.cs) gains RESOLVED/REFINE/BLOCKED (option A) so a signed verdict rides net as a semantic event; guest->host proven in provider-delegation/vm-run-evidence.json; gate closed-loop-readback (await-agent-reply selftest 7/7 + committed closed-loop-readback-receipt.json + net-types assertion). Live: 3 drives from the reviewer VM (senderId WIN) -- closed loop (lbabus ready on VM), release-with-review (ext 0.5.0 launch-to-ready 2604 ms/5 samples PASS via lba-benchmark-summary), verdict announcement (RESOLVED: PASS) -- all over TCP, no GitHub Discussion.

Requirement: The system shall provide a live-only net coordination read side -- a per-actor local receive-log written by lbabus net listen --log and read by lbabus net poll (filtered by type/task; fail-closed without a log) -- so a fail-closed gate proves post->log->poll round-trips over TCP and coordination reads no longer depend on a GitHub Discussion.
Notes: ADR-0040 live-only net coordination: net listen --log appends received frames to a per-actor JSONL receive-log (BusWire.ToJson); net poll reads + filters it by type/task (BusWire.FromJson), mirroring the Discussion poll UX over TCP, fail-closed without a log; the send side (net send) already existed; no central/async store (an offline peer misses the frame -- accepted). Gate net-coordination-log (committed loopback receipt + Net.cs source assertion). Loopback: post->log->poll round-trip + type filter (NOTE/RESOLVED) + poll-without-log fails closed. First increment of retiring the GitHub-Discussion transport.

Requirement: The system shall default the coordination-bus transport to the live-only lbabus net TCP bus (GitHub Discussion becomes a legacy opt-out) AND degrade gracefully when net is unconfigured -- net poll with no receive-log and net send --skip-if-no-peer with no peer both exit 0 with a hint (no error, no dead loopback) -- so a fresh install coordinates over TCP once a peer/log is set and does nothing quietly until then.
Notes: ADR-0045 flip the coordination default to net: busTransport defaults to net across the extension/MCP provider+stdio/post-verdict (Discussion is the legacy opt-out busTransport=discussion / COLLAB_TRANSPORT=discussion); net poll with no receive-log softened from fail-closed to a graceful exit 0 (hint), and the send side passes --skip-if-no-peer so net send with no peer exits 0 (no dead loopback) -- an unconfigured net-default install is a silent no-op until a peer (busNetHosts/COLLAB_NET_HOSTS) and/or receive-log (busNetLog/COLLAB_NET_LOG) is set. Updates the ADR-0041/0042/0043 defaults + softens the ADR-0040 poll fail-closed. npm test covers the extension+MCP default flip; the net-coordination-log receipt covers the graceful poll. Gates net-default-graceful (Net.cs graceful branches + net default) + bus-transport-select (default === net). Off-Discussions step 6; Discussion-transport removal deferred (final).

Requirement: The system shall NOT expose a GitHub-Discussion coordination transport from the lbabus CLI -- the init/post/poll/wait/delta subcommands and the GraphQL Discussion client are removed (GitHubGraphQL keeps only the REST release-tag + issue-comment calls for selfcheck/defect), leaving the live-only lbabus net TCP bus as the sole coordination transport -- so a fail-closed gate proves the CLI carries no Discussion transport.
Notes: ADR-0047 remove the CLI Discussion transport (off-Discussions step 8, final): Program.cs drops init/post/poll/wait/delta + the EnforceVersionOrNull version guard + ParseAll/SeedBody/Eq/Dur; GitHubGraphQL is REST-only (drops Query/ResolveContext/FindDiscussion/CreateDiscussion/EnsureDiscussion/ListComments/AddComment + the DiscussionRef/DiscussionComment records; keeps ListReleaseTags for selfcheck + AddIssueComment for defect); Config drops Category/Title/AgentId/Counterpart/AddressesMe; the 12 discussion/version-guard ci cases are retired (grep+defect+runner-meta remain). The live-only lbabus net TCP bus is the sole coordination transport. dotnet build + a CLI smoke test verify it; gate cli-no-discussion-transport. Doc sweep + mock trim + ollama-bus retirement deferred to step 8b (no gate impact). Completes the off-Discussions migration.

Requirement: The system shall bind extension, AGENTS, lbabus, and human-task SemVer to one release definition, emit deterministic noninteractive task receipts, and admit a stable Marketplace release only after its bytes match the canonical GitHub Release, so review chronology and released system identity cannot drift.
Notes: ADR-0078: one release-components authority binds the extension and independently versioned components. Precommit rejects governed drift. Tasks retain indexed dual-clock receipts and launch Windows npm.cmd through cmd.exe without shell interpolation. Reviewer staging installs Git/rg/gh/glab/.NET and requires lbabus selfcheck PASS. Signing readiness binds the configured public identity to the requested version/quorum purpose, while visual verdicts require exact commit/hash shape. Full KPI receipts bind the clean commit and VSIX with explicit counters. GitHub Release remains canonical; stable Marketplace publication consumes its byte-identical asset.

Requirement: The system shall gate autonomous actor benchmark execution through an enrolled-signer protocol that binds freshness, target plane, allowlisted workload, exact candidate identity, replay state, plus an actor-signed outcome to one request digest.
Notes: ADR-0081: bus-native actors accept only enrolled-requester Ed25519 envelopes bound to dispatch/task IDs, plane, 15-minute-or-shorter freshness, replay nonce, allowlisted workload, and exact candidate commit/tree/bundle digest. Every success, rejection, busy result, or failure is actor-signed and bound to the request digest; artifacts are content-addressed and failures expose only bounded codes. The 11-case selftest proves valid request/success/BUSY paths and rejects expiry, replay, unallowlisted work, mutation, un-enrolled requesters, request rebinding, actor-response tampering, and unbounded failure. Gate mesh-autonomous-actor-protocol.

Requirement: The system shall run each autonomous actor as a persistent cross-platform lbabus service that durably admits one fixed local workload per signed nonce, stores bounded artifacts in guest-local content-addressed storage, and retries cached actor-signed outcomes without re-execution.
Notes: ADR-0082: Linux uses the dependency-free Node 24 daemon under systemd; Windows uses native Windows PowerShell 5 under the activated user's Startup session, with fixed-path OpenSSL for Ed25519 and no Node guest runtime. Both own lbabus listen/send, strict CLAIM binding, exact candidate admission, durable replay state, bounded outcomes, and fixed request-independent workloads. The 31-case actor-service-check includes PowerShell canonical JSON/SHA-256 parity. Live Windows proof survives reboot, accepts an enrolled signed request, returns LabVIEW result 3, and validates the actor-signed response. Gate mesh-autonomous-actor-service.
